name: Apollo-Soyuz Test Project
about: Apollo-Soyuz Test Project (1975-066A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1975 Jul 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1975 Jul 17), held fixed
docked to S08042; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q4068053), noon UTC standing in for the hour; no site given; the point is a stand-in

events.why: landing day from Wikidata; the hour is not given
